verdict.rationale: Chronicle's core product is a sandbox for agents. Agents read and write "simulated services" (twins) through vendor APIs. Production data is turned into staging environments, and custom environments can use recorded HTTP replays, seeded datastores, or standalone twins. Published environment versions are frozen, so every trial starts from the same state. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and explicit documentation guaranteeing isolation from live production systems (e.g., no write-back, data masking).
